listing.name: Mod that kills autofit
listing.summary: Requires nothing, uses a FleetInflationListener to overwrite what autofit fits
listing.aiSummary: Overwrites autofit results by copying s mods from the base fit and installing specific s mods in a defined order.

description:
I accidentally put it in a zip inside a folder inside a zip

Download link

Requires nothing, uses a FleetInflationListener to overwrite what autofit fits

Copies fit s mods if there are any, tries to match amount of s mods if the base fit has less smods than the autofit.

Installs s mod in this order: sARU, expmags if base on fit, reinforced bulkheads, flux distributor, and insulated with no checks.

Does check original variants

Game doesn't crash when removed

No ai used
